name: Title changes, vacancies and accruals move no cash between sites
title: SC-13-14-07 Title changes, vacancies and accruals move no cash between sites
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

When the journey runs from January to the April 10 receipts
Then the title transfers, move-outs and accruals change no cash balance
And no receipt of one site changes the other site's posted operating cash
